author: a
scope: Real Chrome production command search and profile flow with public Iris150; not native Windows installation/update or new WB algorithm accuracy
checks: Public Iris 150 observations loaded with original statistical bindings
Ordinary Chinese command search opens actual review and submission tools without changing scientific project/history
Searching for an already-open profile focuses it and preserves the active draft rather than closing or cancelling it
Actual canvas follows successive width edits; blank/invalid parameters refuse Keep; Save and Cancel preserve committed state, history and raw sources
Local library and bounded profile export contain no image, measurement table or analysis and do not edit the project
Continuous changes Keep as one undo record; Undo and Redo restore profile/dimensions; scientific tables, analyses, images and checkpoints unchanged
Actual SVG physical width and PNG pixel width/embedded DPI match kept profile; existing canonical exporters are used
Shared real-SVG review uses declared thresholds and actual height; excess height reported without crop or false certification
Manual export edits remain available; stale profile dimensions are disclosed, not silently reapplied
Project reopens with profile intact; local library survives new projects; live language switch retains controls and researcher text
1280x720 desktop viewport keeps preview/Keep/Cancel visible while scrolling the profile form
Unknown data fields and conflicting imported profile names refuse atomically; project and local library preserved
Delete and reimport affect only local profile library; project copy remains portable
Pearl Pro uses existing design tokens without changing figure or project state
Controlled profile-storage denial is reported; current fields, project saving and canvas preview/cancel remain usable
No page errors or external requests, including the researcher-entered source URL
aliasScope: Last alias refinement routes fluorescence to the general image-tool chooser, not directly to photo colour. Node actual-command tests check this; no mode is inferred or changed from a search term.
